Delimitation Bill: parisiman se badlega desh ka naksha, bihar ko kitna phayda| Women's Reservation Bill
Kya aane vale samay men bihar ki lokasbha siten 40 se barhkar 60 ho sakti hain? kya lokasbha ki sankhya 543 se barhkar 816 hone ja rahi hai? kya desh ki lokasbha siten 243 se barhkar 365 ho sakti hain? aur sabse bara saval... agar sabhi rajyon ki siten barhengi, to phir dakshin bharat ke rajyon ko isse pareshani kyon hai?...
Bihar aur jharkhand ke taza khabron ke lie dekhte rahie News18 Bihar/Jharkhand
